name: app-6ab9cde238288191841cf1544942d5db
description: Explore your fitness data and create personalized running and strength-training plans with Shape Journey.

interface.longDescription:
Connect your Shape Journey account to ChatGPT to explore your training, nutrition, body progress and recovery data.

Discover what’s driving your progress, identify opportunities to improve, and get practical, personalized guidance to help you reach your goals.

Create tailored running and strength-training plans based on your goals, training history, fitness level, and preferred training strategies, using research-informed methods.

Shape Journey can securely access your records and create personalized training plans without modifying your existing workout logs, meals, or body measurements.
defaultPrompt: Show my active training plans and this week's sessions.
Help me understand my body progress over the last 30 days.
Explore running and strength-training strategies for my goals.

review.commerce_description: An active paid Shape Journey subscription is required to use this MCP integration. The plugin does not offer purchases, checkout, or payment processing. Subscription purchase and billing are handled outside the plugin.
prompts: Show my active training plans and this week's sessions.
What is my planned workout today?
Summarize my body progress over the last 30 days.
What running training strategies are available for my goals?
Preview a strength-training plan using my profile and the strategies I choose. Do not activate it.

positive.description: Demo account with active running and strength plans and scheduled sessions this week. Verify both sports remain visible.
positive.expected_behavior: Call training.get_plan_overview with include_week=true and no sport restriction. Summarize every returned active plan and the returned weekly sessions. Preserve empty states and limitations; do not fabricate sessions or modify plans.
positive.userPrompt: Show my active training plans and this week's sessions.

positive.description: Demo account with today's sessions, or a reproducible rest day. Use the account timezone and current date.
positive.expected_behavior: Read training.get_today_session with no sport restriction. Show all returned sessions and their actual prescriptions. If status is none, explain that no session is scheduled. Do not invent a replacement or write any records.
positive.userPrompt: What workout do I have planned today?

positive.description: Demo account with synthetic body measurements spanning at least 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Call research.get_progress with domain=body and window=30d. Base comparisons on returned measurements, report coverage and data-quality limitations, and avoid claiming causation or inventing absent measurements.
positive.userPrompt: Summarize how my body measurements changed over the last 30 days.

positive.description: Demo account with a completed athlete profile and running goal. No active-plan changes are permitted by this prompt.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the athlete context and call training.list_plan_options with sport=running. Relay only returned goals, strategy slots and options, eligibility, recommendations and reason codes. Ask the user to select options where necessary; do not activate a plan.
positive.userPrompt: What running training strategies can I choose for my goal? Explain which options fit my current level.

positive.description: Demo account with a strength goal and eligible options. In the preceding conversation, obtain training.list_plan_options for sport=strength and have the user select returned strategy IDs and a returned goal_code. Preserve those exact choices.
positive.expected_behavior: Call training.preview_plan with sport=strength, the exact selected returned goal_code and strategy_selection, and locale=en. Present the returned preview and relevant warnings; do not invent exercises, loads or progression. Do not call training.confirm_plan or any other commit tool.
positive.userPrompt: Preview my strength-training plan using the goal and strategies I just selected. Use my profile and do not activate it.

negative.description: Deleting existing workout logs is unsupported. Explain the limitation and do not call any MCP tool or claim deletion.
negative.userPrompt: Delete all the workouts I logged last month.

negative.description: Editing logged meals is unsupported. Explain the limitation and direct the user to edit in the app; no MCP tool should be called and no update should be claimed.
negative.userPrompt: Change yesterday's breakfast in my food log to 500 calories.

negative.description: Clinical diagnosis and medication prescribing are outside the plugin's capabilities. Do not call MCP tools, diagnose or prescribe. Explain the limitation and recommend appropriate medical evaluation.
negative.userPrompt: Diagnose my knee injury and prescribe medication for it.

publication.release_notes: Updated the English description to reflect fitness-data exploration and personalized running and strength-training plan creation. Includes the current Shape Journey MCP endpoint and review cases.
